incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty: HIGH - gpu-pool-gamma memory_pressure (PD#INC-8421) - page fired

pagerduty: PagerDuty notification: Incident INC-8421 - GPU memory pressure detected in pool 'gpu-pool-gamma'.

Dina: acked oncall, taking first look. I'm on mobile atm, ping me with quick summary of affected services.

Ashok: I saw KV cache failures earlier, likely prefix cache thrash. Logs show repeated `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY` on node gpu-gamma-3.

Maria: jumping in. running quick checks now.

Maria: `kubectl get pods -n inference -l pool=gpu-gamma -o wide` shows 3 pods restarting, restartCount 5-12 each.

Maria: logs snippet from inference container (tail):
```
2026-03-14T18:02:11Z ERROR runtime: cuda alloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-14T18:02:11Z WARN kvcache: eviction loop triggered, freed 1.2GB
2026-03-14T18:02:12Z ERROR model-serving: failed to allocate KV cache for request 0x7f8c
2026-03-14T18:02:12Z ERROR runtime: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY: driver api call failed
```

Ashok: thanks. can you `kubectl describe node gpu-gamma-3` and `nvidia-smi` from that host? we need actual GPU mem numbers.

Maria: grabbing `nvidia-smi` output via debug pod (redacting IDs):
```
GPU 0: 24236 MiB total, 23876 MiB used, 360 MiB free
Processes: 8 processes, some orphaned containers
```

Maria: node-level memory is basically exhausted. There's a mix of model-serving and stale containers that didn't die cleanly.

Dina: impact? which customers/routes are failing? any 5xx spikes?

Maria: CloudWatch shows error rate spike on /v1/generate for model:redwood-large-quant at 18:01 UTC - ~12% errors for 8m. Affected: a couple of small SaaS customers on Dedicated; hosted traffic has graceful fallback enabled so degraded but not full outage.

Ashok: mitigation approach: 1) cordon+drain gpu-gamma-3, 2) restart kubelet on node if containers stuck, 3) reduce per-request KV cache allocation temporarily by setting FEATURE_KVCACHE_MAX=0.5 (env override) on runtime deploy for gpu-pool-gamma, 4) enable fallback routing to cpu-backed small model for non-SLA routes.

Dina: ok do 1 and 2 first. Maria, can you cordon and start drain with `--ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data`? keep only evict in progress log.

Maria: running commands now:
```
kubectl cordon gpu-gamma-3 && kubectl drain gpu-gamma-3 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data --timeout=5m
```

Maria: drain in progress. some pods refused eviction due to PDBs, forcing restarts on those.

pagerduty: PagerDuty update: Incident INC-8421 acknowledged by Dina. Escalation timer halted.

Ashok: while drain runs, I'm applying a hotfix config to reduce KV cache per pod: patching deployment inference-runtime-gamma with env `KVCACHE_MAX_FRAC=0.5`.

Maria: hotfix applied. I'm also restarting kubelet on gpu-gamma-3 to clear stuck containers. `systemctl restart kubelet` issued.

Maria: kubelet restart succeeded; previously orphaned container processes cleared. GPU memory freed ~18GB across processes.

Ashok: traffic dropping back. error rate down to ~1.5% and falling. model-serving latency stable.

Dina: good. hold on metrics for another 10m, then plan for followup: drain + repro, full node repro and root cause. Also we need customer comms - minimal, say 'degraded performance for a subset of customers on Dedicated due to GPU memory pressure; mitigated'.

Kevin: hey team, I'm next oncall in ~20m. I'll take the 30m handoff if needed. pls ping me when you start formal handoff. :wave:

Maria: metrics look stable. Scheduling a deeper postmortem runbook item: check autoscaler for not scheduling stale pods, and add a cleanup job for orphaned containers.

Ashok: one more note: traces show a recent rollout changed KVCACHE default from 0.25->0.7 two hours before incident. rollback candidate in staging reproduces OOM under load. will open PR to revert default and schedule gradual rollout.

Dina: file incident ticket in Jira and tag with `severity:high`, link PD INC-8421, assign to Ashok for root cause and Maria for remediation and customer comms. I'll do the handoff to Kevin in 25m.

pagerduty: PagerDuty: Incident INC-8421 status: Resolved (mitigation applied) - acknowledged by Dina.

Dina: resolving thread for now, keeping it monitored. If error rate creeps up we reopen. thanks all. :thumbsup:

Kevin: noted, I'll watch the dashboard and take over if anything flares.

incident-bot: Note: follow-up actions: (1) revert kvcache default change PR #3124, (2) add orphaned-container cleanup cron, (3) run stress test on staging with KVCACHE_MAX_FRAC=0.7 to validate.

Dina: thanks, closing thread at 18:18 UTC.
